name: Armed Evasion (Combat)
body:
You have learned to defend yourself against some magic attacks with your weapon of choice.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus in a melee weapon, (base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 5th).

Benefit(s): While fighting defensively or using the Combat Expertise feat while wielding a melee weapon you have chosen with Weapon Focus you may protect yourself from spells. If you are the target of a spell, including a spell which includes you in its area that requires a Reflex save, you may use your base attack bonus in place of your base save bonus. If the spell targets your AC you may make an attack roll at your highest base attack bonus. If the result of your attack roll exceeds the opponent’s spell attack roll, their attack misses.
